requirements: A readable source artifact exists in a verified local, Dell-indexed, or connected Google Drive source.
The title, author or pen name, length, and development status are grounded in that artifact.
A human or bounded editorial audit has classified the work as suitable for a professional public catalog.
The entry contains no private source path, credential, unpublished manuscript text, or mature-title metadata.
discovery_rule: Search and indexing systems can create review candidates but cannot publish them.
privacy_rule: Excluded and review-needed works are represented only by aggregate private counts; their titles never enter a public bundle.
scope_note: This policy governs the public MobleyBooks catalog. It does not delete, rename, or alter private writing archives.
